skills.name: Odd vs even unison: center mono vs ultra-wide
skills.goal: Choose odd vs even unison voice counts deliberately: odd counts keep a centered, in-tune voice for mono-compatible leads/basses/pads front-and-center in the mix; even counts leave a center gap for ultra-wide L/R leads—then set detune and blend to taste.

skills.name: LFO vs envelope: cyclic vs note-triggered motion
skills.goal: Use LFOs for repeating/cyclic motion (tremolo, vibrato, wobble, WT/PWM drift; audio-rate into AM/FM) and envelopes (ADSR) for note-triggered shapes—amp envelope for dynamics, filter envelope with ±amount for pluck/wah—then route either modulator to WT position or pulse width for evolving pads.

skills.name: Ping-pong delay filtered motion recipe
skills.goal: Build a musical ping-pong (L↔R bouncing) delay for synths/pads: tempo-synced time, moderate feedback, low wet mix, band-limit the repeats, optional saturation, even or offset L/R times, prefer send vs insert, and automate/modulate for evolving motion.

skills.name: Trance-gate: sidechain-gate chop a sustained pad
skills.goal: Turn a long sustaining pad/wall-of-sound (or heavily reverbed short source) into rhythmic stuttered chunks by sidechain-gating it from a silent trigger pattern (e.g. clustered 16ths), then tune gate release for snap and optionally re-space with post-gate reverb.

skills.name: Mono-compatible chord-split hard L/R pad width
skills.goal: Widen a pad without chorus/spreader phase smear: duplicate the synth+MIDI, mute alternating chord tones on each copy (interleaved split), hard-pan L vs R so channels play different notes of the same harmony—yielding extreme width with healthier correlation than chorus/stereo-spread FX.

skills.name: Filter design flavors: ladder, diode, comb, formant
skills.goal: Pick filter *design* (not just LP/HP/BP): ladder/analog-style for classic resonant subtractive tone; diode for EMS/303-ish acid character (retune resonance when switching); formant XY vowel morphs; comb (tiny delayed copy + mix) for peaks/nulls, keyed harmonic shaping, phasing/flanging, and self-oscillation/string-like plucks—then A/B drive+resonance.

skills.name: Sidechain-compressor duck synth/pad group to kick
skills.goal: Make space for a four-on-the-floor kick by sidechain-compressing a synth/pad bus from the kick: insert compressor before reverb on the group, enable external sidechain from kick, use strong ratio (~6:1), fast attack, slower release, and tune threshold so pads pump without wrecking the mix.
